title: Is That Freddy Fazbear?
blurb: Born in the meme layer around Five Nights at Freddy's rather than in the games themselves: breathless, over-excited recognition of a bear. It sounds like a child spotting merchandise in a shop window, and it turned into a running joke about how thoroughly Freddy escaped his own franchise, into films, plush toys, cereal boxes and every school playground on earth. Use it any time something extremely recognisable walks into frame and somebody feels compelled to point it out. Pointing, in this case, is mandatory.
origin: A FNAF fan-meme line about spotting Freddy Fazbear.
